name: CloneKit – Post & Page Cloner
author: prajwal shetty

sections.description:
CloneKit – Post & Page Cloner enables you to clone posts, pages, and custom post types effortlessly with a single click. Duplicated items preserve all terms, custom taxonomies, featured images, and metadata, including full compatibility with page builders like Elementor, Breakdance, and the Gutenberg Block Editor.

Features

  • One-Click Duplication: Instantly clone posts, pages, and custom post types from list tables, edit screens, or the top admin bar.
  • Modern Dashboard UI: A clean, card-based settings interface built with modern WordPress admin design principles.
  • Interactive Live Preview: Real-time visual preview displaying duplicate post titles, custom suffixes, status badges, and redirection targets as you edit settings.
  • Custom Duplication Status: Automatically assign cloned items to Draft, Published, Private, or Pending status.
  • Configurable Redirection: Stay on the current posts list for batch workflows or jump immediately into the editor of your new duplicate.
  • Custom Title Suffix: Automatically append custom suffixes such as “Copy” or “Clone” to duplicated titles.
  • Full Editor Compatibility: Seamlessly integrates with Gutenberg Block Editor, Classic Editor, Elementor, and Breakdance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clonekit-post-cloner folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your duplication preferences under CloneKit in your admin menu.
sections.faq:
How do I duplicate a post or page?

Hover over any item in your Posts, Pages, or Custom Post Types list and click Duplicate This, or click Duplicate This from the top admin bar while viewing any page.

Where do I configure default duplication settings?

Navigate to CloneKit in your WordPress admin sidebar menu. You can set the default post status, redirection target, title suffix, and editor visibility.

Are custom taxonomies and meta fields copied?

Yes. All associated categories, tags, custom taxonomies, and post metadata are cloned to the new post.

Does it support Elementor and Breakdance?

Yes. CloneKit includes built-in compatibility handling for Elementor and Breakdance page builder data.

  • Fast, single-click cloning for posts, pages, and custom post types.
  • Modern, responsive settings dashboard with card-based UI and elevation styling.
  • Interactive live preview showing title suffix, status badge, and redirection in real time.
  • Full compatibility with Gutenberg Block Editor, Classic Editor, Elementor, and Breakdance.
  • Custom duplicate status presets (Draft, Publish, Private, Pending) and customizable title suffixes.
  • Streamlined admin bar shortcuts and row action duplicate links.
